title: Mini Essentials
description: Modern essentials toolkit for Paper featuring subsystem toggles, safe teleportation, Caffeine caching, and Adventure-based messaging.
body:
MiniEssentials is a small, essentials-style plugin that gives your Minecraft server the basic tools most players and staff expect, but without all the heavy extra systems that come with larger plugins. It’s meant for servers that want the essentials experience in a lighter, cleaner form.

Features
Useful Player Utilities

The plugin includes a handful of simple quality-of-life features that make everyday gameplay easier. These cover common actions and conveniences players normally look for, while keeping things straightforward and unobtrusive.

Core Admin Tools

MiniEssentials also provides the basic controls that server staff typically need. These tools help with managing players, adjusting simple gameplay states, and handling routine moderation or maintenance tasks—all without drowning you in menus or configuration.

Simple Permission Structure

Everything is controlled with clear, easy-to-understand permission nodes. Server owners can choose exactly who has access to which features, without needing to dig through complex permission trees.

Full Console Support

All features are built to work properly whether they're used by a player or run from the server console, making remote management and automated tasks more reliable.

Lightweight and Low-Overhead

The plugin avoids big systems like economy, kits, warps, chat formatting, or anything that would add unnecessary bulk. It stays small, loads quickly, and keeps the server running smoothly.

Minimal Setup

MiniEssentials requires very little configuration. Most features work right away with sensible defaults, making it easy to drop into a new or existing server.

Open-Source and Easy to Read

The code is public and written to be understandable, which makes it approachable for anyone who wants to modify it or learn from it.
